Abstract Sculptural Form in White.last_description: A large-scale abstract artwork featuring undulating white forms with pleated textures, resembling folded paper or fabric, mounted on a wall. The composition uses light and shadow to emphasize depth and curvature against a neutral background.

Geometric Abstraction with Orange Circle.last_description: A modern abstract painting featuring a series of vertical and diagonal beige and white stripes creating a tunnel-like perspective, with a prominent orange circular element near the center. The artwork is mounted on a white wall in a gallery setting.

Architectural Model Display.last_description: A wall-mounted display featuring a detailed architectural model of a multi-story building with visible windows and structural elements, presented in a vertical format against a yellow background.

Architectural Courtyard with Palm Tree a.last_description: A serene architectural scene featuring a pink-walled courtyard with an arched opening, framed by a palm tree under a clear blue sky. Two dark silhouetted animals, possibly cats or small dogs, are positioned on the ground, adding a sense of scale and life to the minimalist composition.
